name: stations
label: Stations · Snow telemetry (N. America)
truth_note: Ground truth comes from NRCS SNOTEL telemetry — automated snow pillows and depth sensors high in the mountains, QC’d and voided (for everyone) when sensors glitch.

name: observers
label: Observers · Measured new snow (N. America)
truth_note: Truth is measured new snow from volunteer and NWS observers (CoCoRaHS + NWS COOP, via NOAA GHCN-Daily): a person, a snowboard and a ruler every morning. A day's snow is the next morning's report. Scores resolve ~6 days after each round, once late reports are in.

name: resorts-na
label: Resorts · North America
truth_note: Truth is each resort’s own published snow report, archived twice daily from the resort’s site. Resort numbers run generous — but every team is scored against the same report, so it’s a fair fight; cross-check the ERA5 league for the reanalysis view.

name: alps
label: Alps · Measured new snow (SLF, GeoSphere Austria)
truth_note: Truth is the 24h new snow (HN) measured by the WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF — observers' snowboards at manual study plots across the Swiss Alps (Zermatt, Verbier, St. Moritz, Davos…) plus SLF's automatic IMIS stations, and hand measurements at GeoSphere Austria's climate stations (St. Anton, Obergurgl, Saalbach…). Data © SLF and © GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0.

name: era5
label: ERA5 · Andes / NZ / AU
truth_note: Truth is ERA5 model analysis at each resort’s coordinates (no public southern-hemisphere station API exists — real feeds get promoted as they become available). Scores resolve about a week after each round.

name: resorts
label: Resorts · Southern Hemisphere
truth_note: Truth is each resort’s own published snow report, archived twice daily from the resort’s site. Resort numbers run generous — but every team is scored against the same report, so it’s a fair fight; cross-check the ERA5 league for the reanalysis view.
